title: FPR2 Virtual Screening Benchmark: Agentic AI Skill-Guided vs Naive Protocols
description: Reproducible benchmark comparing naive default protocols against Claude Code AI skill-guided protocols for structure-based virtual screening of FPR2 (formyl peptide receptor 2). Includes 18 Python/Bash scripts (~3100 LOC), curated active/decoy libraries, pre-computed docking scores, evaluation metrics, and a compiled manuscript. Docking performed with Uni-Dock (GPU-accelerated AutoDock Vina) on ~5000 compounds.
